mapper.insert: INSERT INTO procurement_requirement ( tenant_id, title, category, quantity, unit, region, cert_require, deadline, budget, description, status, target_supplier_count, is_public, contact_name, contact_phone, contact_email, create_by ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{title}, #{category}, #{quantity}, #{unit}, #{region}, #{certRequire}, #{deadline}, #{budget}, #{description}, #{status}, #{targetSupplierCount}, #{isPublic}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{contactEmail}, #{createBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE procurement_requirement SET title = #{req.title}, category = #{req.category}, quantity = #{req.quantity}, unit = #{req.unit}, region = #{req.region}, cert_require = #{req.certRequire}, deadline = #{req.deadline}, budget = #{req.budget}, description = #{req.description}, target_supplier_count = #{req.targetSupplierCount}, is_public = #{req.isPublic}, contact_name = #{req.contactName}, contact_phone = #{req.contactPhone}, contact_email = #{req.contactEmail}, update_by = #{req.updateBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'open' AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE procurement_requirement SET status = 'closed' WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status IN ('open', 'completed') AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE procurement_requirement SET status = 'open' WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status IN ('closed', 'expired', 'completed') AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE procurement_requirement SET status = 'expired' WHERE status = 'open' AND deadline IS NOT NULL AND deadline < CURDATE() AND is_deleted = 0
